scope: Preview-server startup cancellation, process/subscription lifetime and UTF-8 log-tail correctness. Disposable real Node child processes and localhost HTTP fixtures; no model calls or user projects.
verifiedCases: Existing localhost HTTP server start, duplicate-start suppression, restart and stop
Actual exit code and bounded log output
Stop during unresolved discovery settles the startup without waiting for discovery
Late discovery rejection does not revive or fail a stopped job
Stop-all cancels unresolved discovery and lazy environment preparation together
Cancelled older launch cannot delete the pending token of its replacement
Concurrent stop callers share one actual child completion
Byte-fragmented valid UTF-8 on stdout and stderr independently stays readable
Ten real short-lived output processes leave no job child/completion/timer references or owned stdout/stderr/spawn/error listeners
After those cycles, waiting beyond the coalescing deadline emits no delayed state events
Discovery and environment failures retain an explicit failed state while clearing pending ownership

retentionContract.stoppedMetadata: Retained for UI status, output and URL; not evicted across arbitrary numbers of project roots.

limits: This is lifecycle/correctness evidence, not a before/after Electron RAM or string-backing-storage benchmark. Cancellation revokes startup but does not abort filesystem or secret-store IO already executing. Stopped metadata and iframe lifetimes remain open; terminal coalescing still lacks renderer-to-producer backpressure. Native application-quit behavior, packaged and cross-platform runtime memory were not exercised by these tests.
followup: Desktop terminal flow control was implemented subsequently; see terminal-flow-verification.json. The terminal limitation above describes this preview-only verification stage.
